notes: What each column prefix of the example spec means, as a hash of its settings and SQL (tests/test_feature_definitions.py). A changed definition takes a new prefix; a retired prefix is never used again, so a name read in the cumulative holdout ledger always means one thing.

act.note: activity_summary: daily means and SDs over the valid wear days (100-45,000 steps) of the window

mainsleep.note: sleep_daily_summary, main sleep with 3-16 h asleep (replaces 'sleep', which had no bounds)

hrfatburn.note: heart_rate_summary, Fat Burn zone minutes per day

hrcardio.note: heart_rate_summary, Cardio zone minutes per day

stepsday.note: steps_intraday minute phenotypes on valid wear days; at least 14 contributing days (a coverage rule added in Phase 35: values are unchanged wherever present)

sleepseg.note: sleep_level main-sleep segments, nights with 3-16 h asleep, at least 14 nights (replaces 'sleepstage')

hr10h.note: minute heart rate on valid wear days with at least 600 heart-rate minutes, at least 14 such days; heart rate in main sleep and awake inactive heart rate from sleepseg and stepsday (replaces 'hrmin')

retired.sleep: main sleep without the 3-16 h bounds (until Phase 35)
retired.sleepstage: sleep segments without night-length bounds or a minimum of nights (until Phase 35)
retired.hrmin: minute heart rate on every valid wear day, however few minutes it had (until Phase 35)
